title: Migration readiness: only a PR that adds SQL needs a current base

source.ref: 2026-10-29: every merge to main re-staled the readiness proof of every open PR, including PRs with no migration, so lanes re-merged main and re-ran CI in a loop (#4298 was knocked back three times). Owner chose option A in the project chat.

verify.note: Reads the runner, publisher and consumer: a no-SQL PR is judged against its own base and exact head; a SQL PR still needs the base to be current main.

detail: scripts/migration-pr-readiness.mjs decides SQL or no-SQL from the PR's own base and head; only the SQL path requires that base to equal current main. scripts/publish-migration-readiness.mjs binds the receipt to the PR's own base and rechecks current main only for SQL results. scripts/verify-migration-readiness.mjs accepts a not_applicable receipt for the exact head whatever main has moved to, and keeps the stale-merge-tree refusal for SQL receipts and for the no-receipt shape. Strict parity, registration pins, staging proof and the source-hash binding to current main for SQL receipts are unchanged. Tests: publish-migration-readiness.cases.mjs, migration-pr-readiness.integration-cases.mjs, verify-migration-readiness.synthetic-job.test.ts. Consequence: freezes apply only to the migration PR being proven.
